example.el: Ο αδελφός μου θέλει έναν φτηνό υπολογιστή.
example.en: My brother wants a cheap computer.

example.el: Αυτό το ψυγείο είναι σε προσφορά.

example.en: I say good morning to the shop assistant.

example.el: Το πρωί πίνω έναν ελληνικό καφέ.
example.en: In the morning I drink a Greek coffee.
In the evening I watch TV.

explain.en: The seller says «Κάνει διακόσια πενήντα ευρώ». The computer has no price in the dialogue.
explain.tr: Satıcı «Κάνει διακόσια πενήντα ευρώ» diyor. Bilgisayarın fiyatı diyalogda yok.

statements.en: Ayşe often listens to the radio.

statements.el: Ο Νίκος πίνει καφέ το πρωί.
statements.en: Nikos drinks coffee in the morning.

explain.en: Ayşe: «Το βράδυ συχνά ακούω ραδιόφωνο» and «το πρωί δεν τρώω ποτέ». Nikos: «δεν πίνω ποτέ καφέ το πρωί»; he drinks tea.
explain.tr: Ayşe: «Το βράδυ συχνά ακούω ραδιόφωνο» ve «το πρωί δεν τρώω ποτέ». Nikos: «δεν πίνω ποτέ καφέ το πρωί»; o çay içiyor.

translation.en: Nikos is waiting for the shop assistant.

explain.en: The shop assistant is the object, and πωλητής is masculine: ο → τον, πωλητής → πωλητή. Την is the feminine article.
explain.tr: Satıcı nesne ve πωλητής eril: ο → τον, πωλητής → πωλητή. Την dişil artikel.

explain.en: The computer is a masculine object, so the adjective follows: καινούργιος → καινούργιο.
explain.tr: Bilgisayar eril bir nesne, sıfat da onu izler: καινούργιος → καινούργιο.

translation.en: Who are you waiting for? — Nikos.

explain.en: The person waited for is a masculine object (τον Νίκο), so ποιος → ποιον. Ποια would be feminine.
explain.tr: Beklenen kişi eril bir nesne (τον Νίκο), yani ποιος → ποιον. Ποια dişil olurdu.

translation.en: What do you eat at midday?

explain.en: The subject is εσύ: τρως. Τρώω is «I», τρώει is «he/she».

text: Χθες {1} στο εστιατόριο, αλλά αύριο {2} στο σπίτι.

translation.en: Yesterday I ate at the restaurant, but tomorrow I'll eat at home.
translation.tr: Dün lokantada yedim ama yarın evde yiyeceğim.

explain.en: Χθες is the past: έφαγα. Αύριο is the future: θα φάω. Έφαγες is the past too, and means «you ate».
explain.tr: Χθες geçmiş: έφαγα. Αύριο gelecek: θα φάω. Έφαγες de geçmiş ve «sen yedin» demek.

rubric.el: Αντιστοιχίζω την ονομαστική με την αιτιατική.
rubric.en: Match each nominative with its object form.
rubric.tr: Yalın halli sözcüğü nesne biçimiyle eşleştir.

explain.en: A masculine noun drops its final -ς and ο becomes τον, also with a name: ο Νίκος → τον Νίκο.
explain.tr: Eril isim sondaki -ς'yi atar ve ο, τον olur; ad da öyle: ο Νίκος → τον Νίκο.

rubric.el: Ποιο άρθρο παίρνει κάθε λέξη ως αντικείμενο;
rubric.en: Which article does each word take as an object? «τον» or «την / το».
rubric.tr: Her sözcük nesne olunca hangi artikeli alır? «τον» mu, «την / το» mu?

explain.en: Only masculine nouns take τον. Feminine nouns take την (η → την), neuter nouns keep το.
explain.tr: Yalnızca eril isimler τον alır. Dişil isimler την alır (η → την), nötr isimler το olarak kalır.

text: Η Αϊσέ θέλει έναν {1} υπολογιστή και μια {2} τηλεόραση.

translation.en: Ayşe wants a cheap computer and a big television.
translation.tr: Ayşe ucuz bir bilgisayar ve büyük bir televizyon istiyor.

explain.en: Υπολογιστής is a masculine object: φτηνός → φτηνό. Η τηλεόραση is feminine: μεγάλη.
explain.tr: Υπολογιστής eril bir nesne: φτηνός → φτηνό. Η τηλεόραση dişil: μεγάλη.

translation.en: Eleni is buying the expensive computer.

explain.en: After τον the adjective is masculine and an object: ακριβός → ακριβό, still stressed on the last syllable. Ακριβή is feminine.
explain.tr: τον artikelinden sonra sıfat eril ve nesne: ακριβός → ακριβό, vurgu yine son hecede. Ακριβή dişil.

text: Με {1} πας στο σινεμά; — Με τη Μαρία.

translation.en: Who are you going to the cinema with? — With Maria.

explain.en: Maria is feminine, so after με you use ποια. Ποιον would be masculine, ποιος is the subject form.
explain.tr: Maria dişil, bu yüzden με'den sonra ποια gelir. Ποιον eril olurdu, ποιος özne biçimi.

translation.en: We eat at the restaurant at midday.

explain.en: Εμείς takes the ending -με: τρώμε. Τρώτε is «you» (plural) and τρώνε is «they».
explain.tr: Εμείς -με ekini alır: τρώμε. Τρώτε «siz», τρώνε «onlar».

rubric.el: Αντιστοιχίζω το πρόσωπο με τον τύπο του «λέω».
rubric.en: Match each person with the form of «λέω».

explain.en: λέω: λες, λέει, λέμε, λέτε, λένε. Λες has one syllable, so it takes no accent mark.
explain.tr: λέω: λες, λέει, λέμε, λέτε, λένε. Λες tek heceli, bu yüzden vurgu işareti almaz.

options: Ποτέ δεν πίνω καφέ το βράδυ.
Δεν ποτέ πίνω καφέ το βράδυ.

explain.en: With ποτέ the verb needs δεν: «Ποτέ δεν πίνω…» (or «Δεν πίνω ποτέ…»).
explain.tr: ποτέ ile fiil δεν alır: «Ποτέ δεν πίνω…» (ya da «Δεν πίνω ποτέ…»).

ask.en: Say «I never drink coffee in the evening.» Which sentence is correct?
ask.tr: «Akşam asla kahve içmem.» demek istiyorsun. Hangi cümle doğru?

ask.en: Match the time and the person with the form of «τρώω».
ask.tr: Zamanı ve kişiyi «τρώω» fiilinin biçimiyle eşleştir.

rubric.en: Match the time and the person with the form of «τρώω».
rubric.tr: Zamanı ve kişiyi «τρώω» fiilinin biçimiyle eşleştir.

explain.en: Χθες takes the past (έφαγα, έφαγες), αύριο the future with θα (θα φάω, θα φας). The ending shows the person: -α/-ω for εγώ, -ες/-ς for εσύ.
explain.tr: Χθες geçmişi ister (έφαγα, έφαγες), αύριο θα ile geleceği (θα φάω, θα φας). Ek kişiyi gösterir: εγώ için -α/-ω, εσύ için -ες/-ς.

translation.en: — What's his name? — His name is Nikos.

explain.en: After τον λένε the name takes the object form: Νίκος → Νίκο. Ελένη is a woman's name.
explain.tr: τον λένε'den sonra ad nesne biçimini alır: Νίκος → Νίκο. Ελένη bir kadın adı.

translation.en: — What's her name? — Her name is Sofia.

explain.en: Sofia is a woman, so the feminine form: την. Before λ the -ν drops: τη λένε. Τον would be for a man.
explain.tr: Sofia bir kadın, yani dişil biçim: την. λ'dan önce -ν düşer: τη λένε. Τον bir erkek için olurdu.

explain.en: The computer is a masculine object: ένας → έναν.
explain.tr: Bilgisayar eril bir nesne: ένας → έναν.
